implemented.cache: Managed rendering uses actual allocator/device-local cache holder and two Maps admitted at 768 before construction, including holder/registry-entry/producer controls. Registry key/owner is removed at disposal; actual Maps/entries clear. Unmanaged global cache identity and output remain.
implemented.planWorking: Admit 512+256*original numeric slots before original Float64Array view/predecessor factories. Retain actual cost view and original predecessor array/node/step objects through original DP. Float64 backing stays under existing pixel admission; original constructor/adoption precedes original fill, so null fill failure can detach actual allocated backing. Original PASS_COST/FETCH_COST loop/Math/tie/cost/step/unshift values and order remain. Drop predecessor/cost references and release pixels/working metadata after production.
implemented.planResult: Admit actual returned Step array at 512+56*ceil(log2 length) before original empty-array/unshift production, covering pointer slots and actual selected two-field step objects. Shrink to 512+56*actual steps before cache insertion; retain actual array across original frame scratch and synchronous consumers. Explicit entry or allocator disposal clears actual array/removes only its own canonical key and slot. Original empty/NaN/invalid-length behavior stays. Direct helper plans use allocator lifetime; internal blur plans/text use the original native device lifetime, clear at preview/device disposal even after scope exit, or allocator-first cleanup.
implemented.shaderWorking: Before original specialization key/closure/Array.from/terms/fetch/template/join producers, admit actual ShaderLifetime at 16384 logical bytes. Private renderer parameters have multiple 2..8 and extra 0..min(multiple-1,3), at most 11 terms; capacity covers original intermediate UTF16 text/arrays/callbacks/full body/key. Capture actual original term arrays, terms, fetch strings, key and final shader body. Clear working arrays/text then shrink actual retained key/body owner to 512+2*(key units+body units). Cache hits release only their fresh working owner; actual canonical cached body remains.
implemented.lifetimes: Retained actual cache Maps, selected step arrays/objects and canonical shader text remain through original frame scratch and consumers, until original device/preview or actual allocator/entry disposal. Each native device has an independent admitted cache tied to its original disposal. The separate direct-plan helper cache has allocator lifetime. Cross-allocator live-device cache borrowing is protected. New allocator has independent cache ownership; original output and per-allocator reuse remain. Failed root/predecessor/term/fill/late Map insertion drops incomplete owners/slots and actual text/arrays without contaminating valid entries; original null and native cleanup/retry are preserved.
